name: By My Side
source:
Ash Lee just wants to survive high school. The thoughts of the future after graduation scare him. His parents never understand him. His crush doesn’t even try to get to know him.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
阿什．李只想熬過高中。想到畢業後的未來，他就害怕。父母從來不理解他。他暗戀的人甚至連試著瞭解他的意思都沒有。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
